name: Musashi-Nitta
tagline: Shinagawa in 26 minutes and Shibuya in 32 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000.
summary: The station is in Ota City, served by Tokyu Tamagawa Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 45 minutes to Otemachi, 42 minutes to Shinjuku, 32 minutes to Shibuya and 26 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. The station stands 5.1 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 1.1 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 5.1 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 4.3 m to 5.4 m, a difference of 1.1 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 0.5 to 3 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 9 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is 0.5 to 3 m. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 2 clinics and 6 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is 東京ちどり病院, about 5 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 栄慈会岩崎内科病院, about 15 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Tokyu Tamagawa Line.
congestion: Tokyu Tamagawa Line runs at 112% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 矢口渡→蒲田, which this station is not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: One room ¥80,000 to ¥90,000, 1K ¥90,000 to ¥100,000, 1LDK ¥140,000 to ¥150,000 and 2LDK ¥180,000 to ¥190,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 8 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 2 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The number of points that fall inside the projected inundation area is about average for a station in the 23 wards.
leads.stationNote: Only the Tokyu Tamagawa Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
